zh-Hans: 位置只保留鼠标附近和固定位置，始终在鼠标所在屏幕打开
固定位置记住上次拖动的位置，重启后继续保留
跨屏时自动调整位置，并限制在屏幕可见范围内
en: Choose Near Mouse or Fixed Position, always on the screen containing the pointer
Fixed Position remembers where you last moved the panel, even after restarting
Saved positions adapt across displays and stay within the visible screen area
